segments.an5.159:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
segments.an5.159:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyī mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
segments.an5.159:1.4: Addasā kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ nisinnaṃ.
segments.an5.159:1.5: Disvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an5.159:1.6: “āyasmā, bhante, udāyī mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desetī”ti [desento nisinno”ti (syā.)].
segments.an5.159:2.1: “Na kho, ānanda, sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
segments.an5.159:2.2: Paresaṃ, ānanda, dhammaṃ desentena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
segments.an5.159:2.4: ‘Anupubbiṃ kathaṃ [ānupubbikathaṃ (sī.), anupubbikathaṃ (syā. pī. ka.)] kathessāmī’ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo;
segments.an5.159:2.6: ‘anuddayataṃ paṭicca kathaṃ kathessāmī’ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo;
segments.an5.159:2.7: ‘na āmisantaro kathaṃ kathessāmī’ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo;
segments.an5.159:2.8: ‘attānañca parañca anupahacca kathaṃ kathessāmī’ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
segments.an5.159:2.9: Na kho, ānanda, sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
segments.an5.159:2.10: Paresaṃ, ānanda, dhammaṃ desentena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo”ti.

lines: Navame anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathessāmīti dānānantaraṃ sīlaṃ, sīlānantaraṃ sagganti evaṃ desanānupubbiṃ kathaṃ vā, yaṃ yaṃ suttapadaṃ vā gāthāpadaṃ vā nikkhittaṃ hoti, tassa tassa anurūpakathaṃ kathessāmīti cittaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
Pariyāyadassāvīti tassa tassa atthassa taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ dassento.
Anuddayataṃ paṭiccāti “mahāsambādhappatte satte sambādhato mocessāmī”ti anukampaṃ āgamma.
Na āmisantaroti na āmisahetuko, attano catupaccayalābhaṃ anāsīsantoti attho.
Attānañca parañca anupahaccāti attukkaṃsanaparavambhanādivasena attānañca parañca guṇupaghātena anupahantvā.
